answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 36163 Country: India Title: Any person having such inability that he cannot fast and if he fasts it will be a life threatening for his health due to no water supply to his body Question: Any person having such inability that he cannot fast and if he fasts it will be a life threatening for his health due to no water supply to his body. What should he do so as to be equivalent to those who can fast easily in the month of Ramadan? Answer ID: 36163 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 71/54/H=1433) If it is temporary disease then he should intend that as soon as he gets cured he shall do the qaza of all missed fasts. But if the disease (excess of thirst) is prolonged and does not hope to get rid of it till death then he should pay the fidya of fasts and do taubah, istighfar and zikr regularly along with reciting the holy Quran and durood. Also he should pay other rights pertaining to Allah and His slaves as well as keep himself aloof from all sins, and be steadfast in taqwah and taharah, then in-sha-Allah his rewards shall not be decreased. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
